Poe Dameron printable slip with a dotted ring around the Resistance emblem, from the 19 May 2016 Set 4 preview PDF.

== Source ==
* Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-4-Preview.pdf#page=1 Set 4 Preview], p. 1, center Poe Dameron slip. This PDF was produced on 19 May 2016 and retains the 4 May date in its heading.

== File details ==
The publisher’s panel was rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip and its printed margin.
